what_it_does.quote: Ogcode is an AI agent that understands your codebase, uses real tools, researches the web, remembers decisions, plans complex work, and ships changes, all from your browser.

who_it_is_for.quote: **Build and fix software**: implement features and fixes across files, run your builds and tests

prerequisites.quote: `CGO_ENABLED=1` is required when building from source: the Swift tree-sitter binding is cgo.

install_per_os.quote: go install github.com/prasenjeet-symon/ogcode@latest   # any OS with Go

first_run_example.quote: `ogcode run "fix the failing test"` runs a one-shot prompt non-interactively and prints to stdout

Your computer, your models, your data, your rules.
**Understand unfamiliar code**: Ogcode maps a project before reading it, outlines files with exact line ranges, and reads only what matters.
**Build and fix software**: implement features and fixes across files, run your builds and tests, and investigate failures instead of retrying blindly.
**Research as you go**: built-in web search and page reading, reusable `SKILL.md` workflows, and external MCP servers.
**Keep context that fits**: recall past decisions instead of replaying the whole transcript, so long sessions stay focused and affordable.
